# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free US freelancer and 1099 tax calculator for 2026: enter revenue and expenses to see self-employment tax, federal income tax with the QBI deduction, a state estimate, quarterly payments and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
